skill: Form the augmented matrix of a non-echelon, nonsingular three-equation system, carry out Gauss-Jordan elimination, and identify its unique RREF or its ordered solution vector.
learner_operation: Read coefficients and constants in x,y,z order, choose legal row swaps/scalings/additions to obtain three unit pivots and zeros above and below each pivot, and match the resulting constants to a five-choice matrix or vector bank.
reasoning_steps: Translate equations into a 3 by 4 augmented matrix, including omitted zero coefficients.
Use row swaps where appropriate and forward elimination with nonzero pivot normalization.
Eliminate above the pivots and read the unique solution in x,y,z order.
Select the matching RREF matrix or ordered vector from the complete bank.
difficulty: moderate; small integer coefficients, occasional fractional intermediate scaling, three pivots, finite five-choice radio response
response_contract: All fourteen source practice questions have one selection radio field with five mathematical choices. Seven ask for RREF and seven for reduction followed by solution. Preserve their respective matrix/vector response families.
invariants: Three variables and three independent equations with a unique solution.
Initial coefficient matrix is not in row echelon form; reduction includes forward elimination rather than only the earlier prerequisite's back elimination.
Use standard Gauss-Jordan row operations and show a coherent worked reduction.
Preserve ordered x,y,z roles, augmented-column semantics, mathematical radio choices and exactly one correct choice.
Singular systems with free variables belong to later lesson knowledge points rather than this one.
permitted_variations: Change integer coefficients and right-hand sides jointly or independently subject to nonsingularity and comparable arithmetic burden.
Vary signed and zero solution components, including homogeneous systems; particular source constants are incidental.
Vary row order, eligible swaps, non-unit pivots, sparse entries and elimination coefficients within the taught operation.
Vary matrix versus vector target across the two observed prompt families.
Vary correct-choice position and distractor relationships; no instructional reason fixes a particular answer-bearing coordinate, label, sign pattern or bank statistic.

fixed_features.justification: tutorial f74e6075-9c2a-5495-ab21-470711559f2a explicitly scopes the general algorithm to a 3x3 system with 3 pivots; later singular knowledge points are separate
the same tutorial states that RREF is unique; all target practice solutions use three pivots

answer_roles.eligible_variation: any moderate signed or zero integer constants compatible with the coefficient system; not fixed by source
position and distractor profile can change without changing the operation
answer_roles.observed: source correct positions vary; banks include sign errors, coordinate errors and fractional values
